name: @post/e2e-settings
description: Project settings e2e (T0109 required test "settings e2e"): real Chromium drives the built web app through the settings tab — the member list and role changes (with the CSRF-bearing PUT wire), the maintainer's locked owner rows, the visibility preview, the purpose/activity-status edit (PATCH wire) and the viewer's no-settings answer. The API is mocked at the network layer with the exact wire shapes cmd/api produces (the Go integration suite locks those shapes against real PostgreSQL).
